channel.title: Kitchen Finds – Small Kitchen Organization
channel.description: Small-kitchen ideas, gadgets and organizing tricks that actually help.

item.title: 6 Under-Sink Organization Ideas That Fit Around Pipes
item.description: Under-sink organization ideas for the kitchen: shelves that fit around pipes, pull-out baskets and a tension rod for spray bottles. Easy small kitchen organization. Contains affiliate links.

item.title: A Simple Fridge Zone System That Cuts Food Waste
item.description: Fridge organization made simple: give each shelf one job, keep raw meat on the bottom and add an eat-first bin so leftovers get used. Easy fridge ideas to reduce food waste. Contains affiliate links.

item.title: 7 Ways to Organize Deep Pantry Cabinets
item.description: Deep pantry cabinet organization ideas: pull-out drawers, turntables, clear labeled bins and shelf risers so you can finally see what you have. Easy pantry ideas for small kitchens. Contains affiliate links.

item.title: 7 Small Kitchen Organization Ideas That Free Up Space
item.description: Small kitchen organization ideas that actually free up space: door racks, tiered spice shelves, under-sink pull-outs and more. Easy wins for apartments and tiny kitchens. Contains affiliate links.
